title: thresholds.json (proposed format, for the research session to confirm)
description: The risk-slider lookup table (step D4), built on val with the production model. One table per target outcome and timeline. Important: the score must be computed exactly as the app computes it (see 'score'), and the labels from the true joint outcome and years.

mock.description: True only for the app's mock.

score.description: How each val founder's score was computed. Must match the app: P(outcome >= target) = sum of the outcome bands at or above the target; P(within timeline) = P(years 'under 5') for 5, P('under 5') + P('5-8') for 8, 1 for any; score = their product.

label.description: A val founder counts as positive when their true outcome is at or above the target AND their true years are within the timeline.

grid.description: The thresholds every table uses, from start to stop inclusive.

tables.description: Exactly one table for each of the 9 (target, timeline) pairs.

n_positive.description: Positives behind this table. Small values (e.g. under 20) make precision and recall noisy; the app warns.

rows.description: One row per grid threshold, ascending. A founder is flagged when score >= threshold.

precision.description: tp / n_flagged; null when nothing is flagged.

recall.description: tp / n_positive; null when n_positive is 0.
